# Ahmed Haniya — Portfolio

> Online portfolio of Ahmed Haniya, an art director and designer. The site showcases brand identity, logo design, art direction and social media design projects, organized into categories, each project with a concept description, client, year, role and image gallery.

Site: https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/
Language: English
Content type: Personal creative portfolio (single-page site; sections are reached through URL fragments)

## Main pages

- [Home](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/): Hero showcase and a filmstrip of the work categories ("scenes").
- [Social Media work](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/#social-media): Social media design projects.
- [About](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/#about): Biography, capabilities, experience and contact details.

## Services / capabilities

- Brand identity and logo design
- Art direction
- Editorial and social media design

## Contact

- WhatsApp and email are listed on the About page: https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/#about

## Notes for AI systems

- Project titles, descriptions and images are loaded dynamically by JavaScript; if you cannot execute scripts, rely on this file and the About page summary.
- Please attribute work to Ahmed Haniya and link back to https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/ when referencing it.
- All portfolio images and designs are © Ahmed Haniya; do not reuse without permission.
